title: NBN POI 2CFS (Coffs Harbour), 2MIR (Miranda), 2GRN (Grafton) - Fibre Splicing Works
current_summary: An upstream network provider will perform fibre splicing that may affect NBN services at the Coffs Harbour (2CFS), Miranda (2MIR) and Grafton (2GRN) POIs. The maintenance window is from 11:00 PM AEST on 13 August to 7:00 AM AEST on 14 August. Some NBN customers in these areas may experience brief interruptions or slower performance. Our team will monitor the work and manage routing where possible to reduce impact. Services are expected to return to normal after the window.

updates.content:
We are planning network maintenance that may affect some NBN services in Coffs Harbour (2CFS), Miranda (2MIR) and Grafton (2GRN). An upstream network provider will be performing fibre splicing between 11:00 PM AEST on 13 August and 7:00 AM AEST on 14 August. During this window, you may notice brief dropouts, slower speeds or higher latency.

Our team will monitor the work closely and route traffic where possible to minimise impact. No action is required from you. Services should return to normal after the maintenance window. If your connection does not recover after 7:00 AM AEST, please power-cycle your modem/router and contact our support team.
